text:
Priya: Heading to Tribeca tomorrow for a customer workshop. Any quick takeout recs near our office? Need at least two vegetarian options, budget ~\$30/person. Also any decent coffee nearby? Thanks!

Maya: For veg: GreenLeaf Deli on Reade has good grain bowls and wraps. Cheap + fast. :leafy_green:

Luca: Also Momo's Dumplings on Church — vegetarian dumplings and big orders are easy to pickup. Pro tip: call ahead. :phone:

Omar: If people want heartier: Hudson Grill does family-style rotisserie + roasted veg sides. Not cheap but great for groups. ~10-15 min walk.

Jules: Coffee rec — Tribeca Roasters on Greenwich. Tiny place but reliable, great pour-over.

Priya: Awesome, thanks. Can someone post addresses/ordering links? I'll put together a quick poll for the team.

Maya: Here you go:
```
GreenLeaf Deli — 123 Reade St (around the corner)
Order: https://order.example.com/greenleaf
Momo's Dumplings — 58 Church St
Call: (555) 212-3434
Hudson Grill — 7 Hudson Ave
Menu: https://hudson.example.com/group-orders
Tribeca Roasters — 90 Greenwich St
Coffee pickup: walk-in only
```

Priya: Poll: who's in for GreenLeaf (fast bowls), Momo's (dumplings), Hudson Grill (family), Sweetgreen (salad). React with 🍚 for GreenLeaf, 🥟 for Momo's, 🍗 for Hudson, 🥗 for Sweetgreen. I'll order based on reactions. @here
